teleport: TeleportService:TeleportAsync + TeleportOptions (ServerScriptService.PlaceTeleport); loading screens assets/vr-mini-golf/ui/loading (Config.UI.LoadingLanternGrove / LoadingSugarloaf)
sync: All three places run the same scripts: games/vr-mini-golf/src is the source of truth. Open ONE place in Studio, then `python3 tools/run_playtests.py push $(find src -name '*.luau')` (picks the only open Studio, or GOLF_STUDIO=<name substring>), run `python3 tools/run_playtests.py smoke`, Save + Publish, close, next place. Each place's role is its workspace attribute PlaceRole (lobby | lantern_grove | sugarloaf_canyon); ReplicatedStorage.Golf.Places holds these IDs. Export (`run_playtests.py export`) from any one place after pushing; the place content (course folders, terrain, Lobby) differs per place, the scripts don't.
